messages:
Maya (UX): quick design question — proposing a small 'Compact summary' toggle in the call timeline so long tool outputs collapse into a one-line digest. reduces noise when debugging multiple invokes. thoughts? Sam (DevEx): +1 for noise reduction. does the toggle persist per-playground or per-session? Maya (UX): default = remembered per user (local setting). could add project-level override later. Jonah (Eng-ML): technical note: collapsing should not drop cached KV traces we need for reruns. we can store full payload in hidden DOM and load on expand. Lily (Design): accessibility nits: ensure toggle is reachable by keyboard, provide aria-expanded on the container, and a descriptive label not just 'Compact'. e.g., 'Show compact summaries for tool outputs'. Carmen (PM): want metrics: retention impact, frequency of expand clicks, and whether compact mode reduces token usage in recorded traces. we should A/B test. Maya (UX): mockup snippet attached (inline):```html
Summary — 2 outputs collapsed • click to expand
``` Sam (DevEx): implementation concern: when collapsed, we still want small telemetry (latency/token counts). can't lazy-drop cost rows. Jonah (Eng-ML): agree — keep token/latency visible even when collapsed. full output loads on expand (deferred fetch for big blobs). Lily (Design): microcopy suggestion: instead of 'Compact summaries' use 'Collapse tool output' or 'Show condensed output' — clearer for new users. also add tooltip: 'Preserve full output; click to expand'. Maya (UX): love 'Show condensed output' + tooltip. also propose a visual affordance for truncated JSON/schema with a small chevron and inline diff badge when schema mismatches expected. Carmen (PM): rollout plan: feature flag off by default for orgs with less than N runs. ramp to all after 2 weeks. track expand rate and support tickets. deploy-bot: deploy request queued — feature-flag: condense-output-toggle -> staging. Sam (DevEx): dev tasks — front-end: toggle state, persisted in localStorage + project setting endpoint; back-end: endpoint to fetch full payload when expand clicked. estimate 3 dev days + 1 QA. Jonah (Eng-ML): I'll add a note to the runtime team: ensure cached traces remain accessible and that deferred fetch respects privacy filters. Lily (Design): accessibility checklist: focus order, aria-expanded, visible focus ring, screen-reader tooltip, and a color contrast check for the chevron. Maya (UX): next steps: Sam to spin a PR with baseline UI; Lily will finalize microcopy and aria labels; Jonah will validate deferred fetch perf; Carmen will own rollout metrics. I'll follow up with a quick mock GIF. Carmen (PM): tagging retention/metrics: ping me if you need an event schema. Sam (DevEx): working on PR today — will tag reviewers @Maya @Lily. Maya (UX): thanks all — no blocking here. will post mock GIF and copy in this thread when ready. :sparkles:
